conclusion.rationale: Patch ITS#9022 adds an opt-in -o remove-sids= option to slapadd. All 8 directed tests pass. BEFORE and AFTER binaries produce identical behavior without the new option (no regression). Option parsing correctly validates SID values, rejects invalid/empty/non-numeric SIDs, and detects serverID conflicts (100% coverage on serverID check path). Coverage gate (80%) not met because deep CSN replacement and contextCSN filtering paths require MDB databases with pre-existing syncrepl context entries. Core option parsing has 82% coverage. No backward compatibility issues detected despite inconclusive formal status due to coverage threshold.
